div.h3: One generic annotation-aware exon-protein framework, FGFR2 as a validated specialization

p.strong: Are protein-domain edges encoded at exon boundaries, and is that relationship conserved across species?

div.p: ExonDomainCompare collects transcripts and proteins for a gene across one or many vertebrate species, selects primary models, maps exons to protein coordinates, annotates domains and topology, and measures how coding-exon boundaries relate to representative domain edges.

g.text: Inputs: gene symbol + species list (>= 1 species)
Single-species and multi-species use the same pipeline
